name: Guess the Crop
tagline: Paused for a PRD pass — back with a sharper game design.
description: WIP — v3 paused for PRD pass after surfacing targeting and visual-differentiation issues (chips show 4–8 fields with no target indicator; chip filenames leak the answer; year filter is invisible to the player). The mechanic returns once the design is sharper. Prior shape: Real Sentinel-2 chips, CDL ground truth, 33 CONUS fields, four-option pick, eight rounds, score tally. The educational lift is the difficulty itself — sometimes even with real images it's hard, and that's why satellite ag-analytics is non-trivial.
